decode_barcode — 2D barcode op

• Data kinds: image → feature

• Call: fullseye.apply(img, "decode_barcode", a=0.5, b=0.5) (the 2-D model is one image plus two scalar knobs a,b∈[0,1])

• HALCON equivalent: find_bar_code (the HALCON reference is a useful guide to its meaning and parameters)

*The figure is the actual output on a synthetic 128×128 input. Left: input, right: output. Point clouds are drawn as a top-down scatter (brightness = z), 1-D series as a line plot, volumes as the maximum-intensity projection along z, videos as the middle frame, complex images as magnitude; return values that are not pictures are shown as the values themselves.*

Sweeping knob a (0.1 / 0.5 / 0.9, the other knob at its default):

▸ decode_barcode: knob a sweep (docs site)

*Knob b does not change the output (measured: identical at 0.1 / 0.5 / 0.9).*

Usage

A simplified barcode-like feature that counts the number of light/dark transitions along the central scan line. This resembles but is not the same as HALCON's `find_bar_code` (Detect and read bar code symbols in an image.) - it performs no symbology determination or data decoding whatsoever (it only counts the "number" of bars).

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

`a が「暗い」とみなすしきい値を 0.3〜0.7 に振る。b は未使用。画像中央の行（v.shape[0]//2）だけを見て、v < しきい値` の画素を 1 とした列に対し、0→1 に立ち上がる回数（暗いバーの本数）を数える。実際のバーコードのデータ（数字・文字列）は得られない。
